protocol.texts: live agent messages of the trials in results/pilot-4a, results/pilot-4b
protocol.agreement: a judge item agrees when the two verdicts are equal and an extract item when the two values are equal; quotes are not compared
protocol.unknown: unknown is kept as a verdict: it agrees only with unknown, and no item is dropped for it
protocol.invalid: a live call with no answer (refused, or invalid twice) never agrees and is listed with its error
protocol.excluded: mock trials and trials with no grade are not read; a trial this checkout cannot regrade is listed in trials.excluded; a question no trial recorded an answer for, or that trials answered differently, stays in questions and is listed as a disagreement
protocol.pooling: one task per file: agree is pooled over the task's questions; every live answer is in live_entries and each disagreement lists both answers

probes.criterion: The text asks someone to get in touch with the patient: to call, phone, text, email, write to, mail or message them, or otherwise reach out to them. A text that says not to contact the patient, that only updates or asks about the chart or registry, that orders or arranges care without saying to reach the patient, or that invites the reader to contact the writer, does not meet this.
